cards.public_summary: Jacob Westendorf reports that Josh Jacobs faces two misdemeanor charges filed by the Brown County District Attorney’s Office.
cards.evidence:
The Josh Jacobs situation took a turn this week with the Brown County District Attorney Office formally filing charges for two misdemeanors. As of now, however, the Packers and Jacobs are working through the legal process.

cards.public_summary: Chris Bell made his preseason debut after December ACL surgery, catching two passes for 22 yards on a team-high five targets.
cards.evidence: For someone who had ACL surgery in December, Chris Bell had one of the most impressive recoveries from such a major injury. In his preseason debut, he caught two passes for 22 yards and led the team with five targets.
cards.commentary: Bell’s preseason debut is a positive availability sign after ACL surgery. The target volume came in one exhibition and does not establish a regular-season role; his practice participation and roster status are next to monitor.
cards.author: Alex Villasis​
